// CASE ts_top_const_vs_param_property expect=pass
const width = 1;
class Importer {
  constructor(private readonly width: number) {}
  async run(items: string[]) {
    await mapLimit(items, this.width, save);
  }
}
// CASE ts_top_const_vs_inner_type_annot_destructure expect=pass
const limit = 1;
export async function run(items: string[], options: { limit: number }) {
  const { limit }: { limit: number } = options;
  await mapLimit(items, limit, save);
}
// CASE end expect=pass
